/* Fixed, readable navigation, with mobile access to every section */
html{scroll-padding-top:106px}
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;width:100%;z-index:90;background:rgba(5,25,47,.96);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.14);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.nav .nav-inner{min-height:84px}
.nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lime);outline-offset:4px}
@media(max-width:750px){.nav .nav-inner{height:auto;min-height:65px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding-top:9px;padding-bottom:9px}.nav .logo{flex:0 0 100%;font-size:19px}.nav .logo small{margin-top:3px}.nav .nav-menu{display:flex;width:100%;gap:19px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;padding:7px 0 10px;white-space:nowrap}.nav .nav-menu a:not(.pill-btn){display:inline-flex;font-size:10px}.nav .nav-menu .pill-btn{padding:9px 12px;flex-shrink:0;font-size:10px}.hero{padding-top:175px}html{scroll-padding-top:135px}}

/* Creative refinements and responsive support */
.community-preview{aspect-ratio:1.43;background:#f4f7fc;border:1px solid #cdd9e8;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;color:#16314b;text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(7,29,50,.13);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.forum-top{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;background:#fff;padding:11px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #dce5f0;font-size:12px}
.forum-mark{font-size:20px;color:#ff5c27}.forum-label{margin-left:auto;background:#e9f3ff;color:#005b9b;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:16px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.forum-post{padding:12px 13px;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}.forum-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.forum-meta small{font-weight:500;color:#586e83}.forum-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:25px;height:25px;background:#d6e9ff;border-radius:50%;flex:none;font-size:12px;color:#14508b}.forum-avatar.pro{background:#c8fa54;color:#142b3c}.forum-post h4{font-size:clamp(12px,1.14vw,16px);line-height:1.22;margin:9px 0 6px;color:#0a2b49}.forum-post>p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;color:#40536b;margin:0 0 10px}.forum-response{display:flex;gap:8px;background:#e8f3e8;padding:8px;border-radius:8px}.forum-response b{font-size:10px;color:#143851}.forum-response p{font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;margin:3px 0 0;color:#263f50}
.benefit{transition:transform .28s ease,box-shadow .28s ease}.benefit:hover{transform:translateY(-9px)}.benefit img{transition:transform .38s ease}.benefit:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}.benefit{overflow:hidden}.brand-card{transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}.brand-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 22px 40px #0005}.arrows button{transition:transform .2s,background .2s}.arrows button:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.nav{backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}section[id]{scroll-margin-top:92px}a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #91d5ff;outline-offset:3px}
@media(min-width:751px) and (max-width:1100px){.container{padding-left:28px;padding-right:28px}.nav-menu{gap:11px}.nav-menu a{font-size:10px}.nav-inner{gap:12px}.logo{font-size:23px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,85px)}.benefits{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:17px}.benefit img,.community-preview{aspect-ratio:1.65}.forum-post h4{font-size:16px}}
@media(max-width:750px){.community-preview{aspect-ratio:1.55}.forum-post h4{font-size:15px}.forum-post>p,.forum-response p{font-size:11px}.benefit:hover,.brand-card:hover{transform:none}.nav-menu{max-width:64%;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}.nav-menu::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.nav-menu a:not(.pill-btn){display:inline-block;flex:none}.nav-menu a{font-size:10px}.nav-inner{gap:8px}.logo{font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}.logo small{font-size:6px}.nav-menu{gap:13px}.nav-menu .pill-btn{display:none}.brands-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.brands h2{max-width:420px}}
@media(max-width:430px){.nav-menu{max-width:54%}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(37px,11vw,57px)}.community-preview{aspect-ratio:1.4}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.benefit,.benefit img,.brand-card,.arrows button{transition:none}}
.community-ribbon{display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:19px 25px;background:var(--lime);color:#071c31;font:800 clamp(10px,1vw,13px) Manrope,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.11em;text-align:center}.community-ribbon b{font-size:20px}@media(max-width:750px){.community-ribbon{gap:10px 14px;padding:17px 12px}.community-ribbon span{font-size:9px}.community-ribbon b{font-size:12px}}
/* Brand carousel rebuilt around independent image assets */
.brands-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(225px,285px) minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start}
.scroller{min-width:0;gap:18px;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;scroll-padding-inline:2px;padding:6px 3px 20px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#b8c7d1 transparent}
.scroller::-webkit-scrollbar{display:block;height:6px}.scroller::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#68879b;border-radius:9px}
.brand-card{flex:0 0 clamp(235px,27vw,320px);width:clamp(235px,27vw,320px);height:auto;align-self:stretch;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:16px;background:white;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.23);scroll-snap-align:start;box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.17);overflow:hidden}
.brand-card:after{display:none}

.brand-card .brand-visual img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;background:#0c2235}
.brand-copy{padding:22px 21px 26px!important;background:#fff;color:#102d48;flex:1;min-height:174px}

.brand-copy h3{margin:11px 0 9px;font:700 clamp(19px,2vw,24px)/1.2 'DM Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:#0b2a44}
.brand-copy p{font:400 14px/1.55 'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:#43576b;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.brand-card:focus-within,.brand-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);transition:transform .18s ease}

.nav{position:sticky;top:0;background:#061d32;z-index:100;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #00172a33}.nav-menu{min-width:0}.nav-menu a{white-space:nowrap}html{scroll-padding-top:94px}

/* FINAL RESPONSIVE DESIGN SYSTEM: visual hierarchy and layout fixes */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:110px}
body{max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
.container{width:min(1200px,100% - 44px);margin-inline:auto;min-width:0}
section{min-width:0}
img{max-width:100%}
/* Sticky nav with all navigation entries accessible */
.nav{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:1000;background:#061c30!important;isolation:isolate}
.nav .nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:80px;height:auto}
.nav .logo{flex:0 0 auto;line-height:1.1}
.nav .nav-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(8px,1.3vw,24px);min-width:0;max-width:none;width:auto;overflow:visible;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.nav .nav-menu a{flex:0 0 auto;display:inline-flex!important;white-space:nowrap;font-size:clamp(10px,.85vw,12px)}
/* Branding section: all designs kept uncropped, captions always separate */
.brands{overflow:hidden}
.brands-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(230px,280px) minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start;gap:24px}
.brands-layout>div{min-width:0}
.brands .scroller{display:flex;min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;gap:16px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-padding:0 6px;padding:6px 4px 20px;margin:0}
.brands .brand-card{position:relative!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-self:stretch;flex:0 0 270px!important;width:270px!important;min-width:0!important;height:auto!important;max-width:none!important;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transform:none}
.brands .brand-card::before,.brands .brand-card::after{content:none!important;display:none!important}
.brands .brand-visual{height:360px!important;min-height:360px!important;max-height:360px!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 360px!important;background:#071e32;padding:12px!important;overflow:hidden}
.brands .brand-visual img{display:block!important;width:auto!important;max-width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;border-radius:7px}
.brands .brand-copy{position:relative!important;display:block!important;flex:1 0 auto!important;min-height:175px!important;max-height:none!important;padding:20px 18px 24px!important;background:#fff!important;color:#102d48!important;overflow:visible!important;transform:none!important}
.brands .brand-copy h3{font:700 20px/1.22 'DM Sans',sans-serif;margin:10px 0;color:#102d48;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.brands .brand-copy p{font:400 14px/1.55 'DM Sans',sans-serif;margin:0;color:#42566b;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.brands .brand-number{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em}
/* All other layout areas remain inside viewport */
.intro,.brands,.section,.packages,.faq,.contact-section{max-width:100%}
:is(.benefits,.process-grid,.proof-grid,.price-grid,.about-grid,.contact-grid)>*{min-width:0}
.contact-form input,.contact-form select,.contact-form textarea{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
@media(max-width:1080px){
 .nav .nav-inner{gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 0}
 .nav .nav-menu{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;gap:clamp(11px,2vw,23px);flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scrollbar-width:thin;padding:8px 0 10px}
 .nav .nav-menu a{font-size:12px}
 .brands-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
 .brands .scroller{margin-top:10px}
 html{scroll-padding-top:145px}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
 .container{width:calc(100% - 32px);padding-inline:0!important}
 .nav .nav-inner{display:block;min-height:0;height:auto;padding:12px 0 8px}
 .nav .logo{display:block!important;font-size:19px}
 .nav .nav-menu{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow-x:auto!important;gap:19px;flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:flex-start;scrollbar-width:thin;padding:12px 0 10px}
 .nav .nav-menu a,.nav .nav-menu a:not(.pill-btn){display:inline-flex!important;font-size:11px;flex:none}
 .nav .nav-menu .pill-btn{display:none!important}
 .hero{padding-top:65px!important;min-height:560px}
 .hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,10.8vw,65px)!important;line-height:1.03;max-width:100%}
 .hero .container{max-width:100%}
 .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
 .benefits{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .benefit,.benefit:last-child{grid-column:auto;max-width:none!important}
 .brands{padding-block:60px!important}
 .brands .scroller{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important;overflow:visible!important;gap:20px!important;padding:0!important;scroll-snap-type:none!important}
 .brands .brand-card{width:100%!important;max-width:430px!important;min-width:0!important;flex:none!important;margin-inline:auto}
 .brands .brand-visual{height:340px!important;min-height:340px!important;max-height:340px!important;flex-basis:340px!important}
 .brands .brand-visual img{max-height:315px!important;max-width:240px!important}
 .brands .brand-copy{min-height:0!important;padding:20px 22px 24px!important}
 .brands .arrows{display:none!important}
 .contact-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .contact-form .full{grid-column:auto}
 .contact-actions .pill-btn,.contact-actions .outline-btn{max-width:100%;text-align:center}
 .forum-post{overflow:visible!important}
 html{scroll-padding-top:115px}
}
@media(min-width:651px) and (max-width:850px){
 .brands .brand-card{flex-basis:260px!important;width:260px!important}
 .benefits{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
